install.title: Initial setup
install.heading: SuperAdmin account
install.body: The first step creates a local SuperAdmin account. The password is stored only as a hash. Break-glass sign-in remains available after Entra AD is selected later.
install.createdBody: This account is local-only and remains available for break-glass sign-in. Later wizard steps continue after this one.
install.passwordMismatch: Password and confirmation do not match.
install.errorInvalid: SuperAdmin details are invalid. Check the email, display name, and password (at least 12 characters).
install.errorDuplicate: The initial SuperAdmin already exists or the email is already in use.
install.errorGeneric: The SuperAdmin account cannot be saved right now.

loginProvider.heading: Sign-in method
loginProvider.body: Select exactly one authentication provider. SuperAdmin remains a local break-glass account when Entra AD is selected.
loginProvider.localHint: Sign-in stays on local accounts. AD/Entra fields are not required.
loginProvider.entraHint: Enter Entra tenant and client identifiers or LDAPS bind details. Role mapping stays in Settings.
loginProvider.configured: Already saved. Leave empty to keep the current value.
loginProvider.breakGlass: The local SuperAdmin remains available for break-glass sign-in.
loginProvider.errorIncomplete: For Entra AD enter tenant and client, or complete LDAPS bind details.
loginProvider.errorInvalid: The sign-in configuration is invalid or incomplete.
loginProvider.errorGeneric: The sign-in method cannot be saved right now.

smtp.heading: SMTP
smtp.body: Enable SMTP for outbound email or leave it off. Off forcibly disables the email addon.
smtp.offHint: SMTP fields are not required. The email addon stays off and cannot be enabled while SMTP is off.
smtp.onHint: Enter SMTP host, port, TLS, username, password, and from address. The password is stored as a secret.
smtp.configured: A password is already saved. Leave empty to keep the current value.
smtp.errorIncomplete: When SMTP is on, enter host, port, username, password, and a valid from address.
smtp.errorInvalid: The SMTP configuration is invalid or incomplete.
smtp.errorGeneric: The SMTP configuration cannot be saved right now.

seed.heading: Initial data
seed.body: This creates the minimum needed for routing: one organizational unit, a fallback group, one service, and routing to that group. Demo tickets are not created.
seed.createdBody: Minimum data is ready. The origin OU and service resolve to the fallback group.
seed.errorGeneric: The initial data cannot be saved right now.

addons.heading: Add-ons
addons.body: Turn optional modules on or off. Core capabilities (ticketing, routing, inbox, RBAC, audit, in-app notifications, attachments) stay on. A disabled add-on can be enabled later in Settings.
addons.emailDisabledHint: Email stays off until SMTP is enabled.
addons.errorUnsupported: One or more add-ons are not in the catalog.
addons.errorGeneric: The add-ons cannot be saved right now.

sla.label: SLA
sla.description: SLA profiles, calendars, and overdue escalation.

email.label: Email
email.description: Outbound email channel. Requires SMTP to be enabled.

edge.label: Edge
edge.description: Browser extension for quick replies and remote requests.

teamsStub.label: Teams (stub)
teamsStub.description: Teams feature flag without actual message delivery.

csat.label: CSAT
csat.description: Satisfaction survey after a ticket is closed.

autoAssign.label: Auto-assign
autoAssign.description: Least Busy / Round Robin assignment inside a group.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.description: Approval flows on services that require them.

confidential.label: Confidential tickets
confidential.description: ACL and break-glass for confidential requests.

kbIntercept.label: KB intercept
kbIntercept.description: Show knowledge base articles before submitting a ticket.

timeTracking.label: Time tracking
timeTracking.description: Track time spent on a ticket.

bulkActions.label: Bulk actions
bulkActions.description: Bulk inbox actions, without bulk close.

complete.heading: Finish setup
complete.body: The wizard will lock. Further changes go through Settings.
complete.errorGeneric: Setup cannot be locked right now.

routing.title: Routing
routing.intro: WHEN origin OU + service THEN group. If there is no exact rule, the parent OU is used. If no route exists, the request stays UNROUTED.
routing.coverageEmpty: No service and OU combinations are available for coverage.
routing.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required to view routing.
routing.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to change routing.
routing.errorDuplicate: A rule already exists for this OU and service.

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.intro: Search and articles. Owner and review/stale status are visible on each article.
knowledgeBase.empty: No articles you are allowed to see.
knowledgeBase.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required to view the knowledge base.
knowledgeBase.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to change articles.
knowledgeBase.errorGeneric: The knowledge base is currently unavailable.

session.error: Sign in failed. Check the email and password.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.intro: Inbox, assigned work, and request creation. Before submitting a ticket, the system suggests knowledge base articles.
tickets.priorityHint: Priority is calculated from impact and urgency.
tickets.availabilityUnavailable: This service is currently unavailable. Ticket creation stays possible.
tickets.noActiveForm: This service has no active form. You can still submit a title and description.
tickets.interceptIntro: Review suggested articles before creating a ticket. Your form data is kept.
tickets.interceptEmpty: No articles for this service. You can continue and create a ticket.
tickets.helpedSkip: You marked an article as helpful. You can still create a ticket if needed.
tickets.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required for tickets.
tickets.errorForbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
tickets.errorInvalidTransition: This status change is not allowed.
tickets.errorConflict: This action conflicts with the current state.
tickets.errorCatalog: The service catalog is currently unavailable.
